# Business Process Pattern Audit

Problem: A business has fragmented operational events and wants to discover the real recurring workflow, cycle time and exception points without replacing its current systems first.
Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: human_auth_handoff
Public capability: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=buildflow-process-audit-machine-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=buildflow-process-audit-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- map how our process actually works
- find bottlenecks in this business workflow
- analyze our purchase approval process
- reconstruct our process from logs
- where are exceptions slowing us down
- audit our procure to pay workflow
- compare the real workflow to company policy
- process mining from operational history

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
